item.title: Vegetable Prices in Guwahati Have Become a Barometer of Economic Stress
item.description: From tomatoes to chillies, Guwahati’s vegetable markets have steadily eaten into household budgets since the pandemic Over the past five years, a staple of every Indian kitchen, vegetables has become a gauge of economic pressure in Assam’s largest city.
